current.body:
Hi Liam and Zara,

Thanks for the time today. Ravi showed your card transaction sample streaming at about 3 thousand transactions a second, with features like spend velocity per card updating in under 5 seconds. He also showed the fraud features feeding your scoring model and the case export to your case tool.

Open items:
- Zara is sending the case tool custom field list tomorrow. Once it arrives, Ravi will test custom fields in case export. We have not set a date for that test yet.
- Helen asked for a cost comparison against building this in house. Liam, could you share what the engineering lead's six month estimate assumes, so we can discuss how to approach it?
- I will check Helen's contract terms with our deal desk and come back to you.

We have not set a date for our next conversation. Could we agree on a time early next week?

Nora

Thanks for your time today. Ravi showed your card transaction sample streamed at about 3 thousand transactions a second, with features like spend velocity per card updating in under 5 seconds. - I will check Helen's contract terms with our deal desk.

Liam, you mentioned talking next week. What day and time work for you?

Nora
